# Alternate representation regression programs

`alternate_title_programs.json` contains retained MusicBrainz ensembles and local
Track evidence from the real-profile reconciliation disposable copy, observed
2026-10-19. Angle includes all three sampled Releases, not just the clean native
program; Dreams includes the inserted Track and edition/version annotations.
Work, Underwater, Freshman Year, 100 Onces and the More Skin remaster are controls.

Application Track/source IDs and provider occurrence links in local evidence were
removed; source title/position observations duplicated the effective values and
were omitted. Artist/Recording evidence and sampled provider programs retain their
actual values. Tests allocate opaque fixture IDs and require no provider requests.
No fixture titles or Group IDs are used by production matching.
